items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Wilson was coming out of Willie Bryant's band.

ctx.x: Wilson was coming out of Willie Bryant's band. You see, so we were all Savoy people, you know. So they were trying to keep us there.

Going back to when you first came to New York, was there anything like different about working in New York as opposed to where you've been before? Like, were the audiences different? Was there more pressure on the musicians?
